value.text: A unit cell emits a single photon.
The router sends the photon into acolumn of unit cells. CZ gatesentangle it with the atoms.
The router holds it, then redirectsit to a different column.
More CZ gates bond it to atoms inthe second column.
The router carries it on todetection.
A nanowire detector registers thephoton and emits a digital signal.
The processor decodes errors in realtime and directs routing, photongeneration and atom preparation.
